records.translation_ar: خلل مكوّن بطارية الطوارئ في وحدة الاتصالات نتيجة انخفاض جهدها (بحسب تطبيق TCU)

model_years.model_specific: Velar 18-20MY; RR/RR Sport/Discovery 18MY onward; Evoque/Discovery Sport 18-20MY

causes_evidence: TCU uses internal backup battery when vehicle 12V battery has been flat.
diagnostic_steps: Connect approved scan equipment and main-battery support; inspect TCU backup-battery voltage
If back-up battery voltage <3.3 V, assess/charge 12V startup battery, then run engine at least 60 minutes (Power Mode 7)
Verify back-up battery voltage >3.9 V, clear DTC and wait 10 seconds, rescan
Do not replace backup battery immediately per SSM75647
